utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive! I’m a bit scattered today, but I’m happy to help out however I can.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Amazing, Oren—thank you! I’ll send you the details and we can use all the help we can get.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Noah, sorry I’m late—what’s the update on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — the repair drive. I think it’s still going okay, but I may have missed the latest changes.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can help, but I’m a bit worried about the timing and where we’re storing everything. Do we have enough boxes and a place to drop it all off?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’m not sure yet, but I can check on boxes and a drop-off spot today.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sounds good — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, that’s great — we mainly need folks to help sort donations and hand out flyers, if you’re up for it.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’ve got the repair drive organized, Opal — we’re set to start gathering the tools and sorting the requests. If you’ve got anything urgent, send it my way and I’ll add it to the list.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, I’ll check my place for anything urgent and let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can keep an eye on our supply list for the repair drive—just tell me what we’re short on.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm what we’re short on first?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, I heard the repair drive’s getting a good bit of support already — that’s encouraging. I’m happy to help keep an eye out for anything they still need.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That’s great to hear — thank you. I’ll keep track of what’s still needed and let you know if anything else comes up.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Could you help sort the donations and load the boxes into my car on Saturday morning?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Hey Uli, I’m ready for the repair drive—just tell me the time and place.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Leo. Let’s meet at my place at 6 by the front gate.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard the repair drive's picking up, but I’m still catching up on the details—what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Mostly just help spreading the word and pointing folks to the sign-up sheet. I’m still gathering the final list, but if you can mention it around the block, that’d be great.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Jules — I can bring over my tools for the repair drive. Just tell me what you need fixed first.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Gus — that’s a big help. Let’s start with the loose fence by the side yard, and then we’ll see what else needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’d like to double-check the repair drive details first—what exactly do you need help with, Mara?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m looking for a few volunteers to help sort donations, label items, and hand out supplies on Saturday. If you can only do one part, that would still be a big help.
